productionReady.name: Lillomarka

coordinate.coordNote: Eksakt navngitt Lillomarka-relation med woodland/multipolygon-geometri, revalidert mot current main. Punktet representerer det store skogsområdet og er ikke et tilfeldig utfartssted eller en løypestart.

productionReady.representationLock: One broad named Marka/woodland place. Individual lakes, cabins, trails and trailheads remain separate places or content layers where independently justified.
sourceBasis: Oslo kommune's Oslomarka guidance treats Lillomarka as one of the named Marka areas and documents its recreational and nature values.
Exact OSM woodland relation provides the physical area identity.

productionReady.name: Grorudparken

coordinate.coordNote: Eksakt navngitt Grorudparken-polygon, revalidert mot current main. Parken er en egen offentlig landskaps- og møteplassidentitet langs Alna og skal ikke kollapses til bydelen Grorud eller Groruddammen.

productionReady.representationLock: The named public park landscape from Grorud centre toward Hølaløkka. Groruddammen remains a separate exact water/recreation sub-place.
sourceBasis: Oslo kommune describes Grorudparken as a park along Alnaelva from Grorud centre toward Hølaløkka with recreation areas and Groruddammen within the wider landscape.
Exact OSM park polygon provides the physical area identity.

productionReady.name: Åmot bru

coordinate.coordNote: Eksakt navngitt broobjekt for Åmot bru, revalidert mot current main og navnevariantene Aamot/Åmot. Markøren representerer selve den historiske jernhengebroen.

productionReady.representationLock: The exact historic bridge object. The surrounding Akerselva landscape remains a separate broader place system.
sourceBasis: Oslo byleksikon documents the 1851 iron chain suspension bridge, its original location at Åmotsund, relocation to Akerselva in 1957 and its distinctive historical inscription.
Exact OSM bridge geometry provides the physical object identity.

productionReady.name: Klosterenga skulpturpark

coordinate.coordNote: Eksakt navngitt Klosterenga park-polygon, revalidert mot current main. Canonical scope er hele skulptur-, vann- og parkmiljøet, ikke ett enkelt kunstverk.

productionReady.representationLock: One sculpture-park/public-art landscape identity. Individual artworks may remain separate exact objects only where the existing public-art model independently supports them.
sourceBasis: Oslo kommune defines Klosterenga as a sculpture park where art, water and green public space are integrated, developed from Bård Breivik's vision and completed with the reopened Hovinbekken.
Exact OSM park polygon provides the whole-site physical identity.

productionReady.name: Peer Gynt-parken

coordinate.coordNote: Eksakt navngitt Peer Gynt-parken-polygon på Løren, revalidert mot current main. Markøren representerer den samlede skulpturparken, ikke ett enkelt Peer Gynt-verk.

productionReady.representationLock: One sculpture park combining literature, public art and neighbourhood landscape. Individual sculptures remain content layers unless separately canonical under the public-art model.
sourceBasis: Peer Gynt-parken's own current site describes a public sculpture park at Løren with international artists interpreting Henrik Ibsen's Peer Gynt.
Oslo kommune's Byplan material treats the park as a neighbourhood meeting-place and sculpture park.
Exact OSM park polygon provides the physical area identity.

pending.name: Brekkedammen ved Frysja
pending.reason: The exact named OSM object is the weir itself, only 25.2 m from the existing Brekke power-station place. VisitOSLO and Oslo kommune define the candidate as the broader named bathing/recreation place, so the weir alone cannot silently become the whole-site coordinate.
